title: Personal account
intro: Save documents, build your own selections and return to earlier searches. The account is optional: the catalogue, search and exhibitions are open without registration.
noRequests: The account has no applications, orders or payments. Requests to the archive are filed through eGov.kz and e-Otinish.

unavailable.title: The account is temporarily unavailable
unavailable.text: The rest of the site works without it. Try opening the account later.

features.title: What the account gives you
features.favorites: Documents, exhibitions and news you want to come back to.
features.selections: Your own themed lists of documents from favourites.
features.searches: Saved queries you can repeat with one click.
features.subscriptions: Marks for the topics you care about: news and new exhibitions.

lead.login: Enter the email and password you registered with.
lead.register: Only an email and a password are needed. No other data is requested.
lead.reset: Enter the email the account is registered with. We will send a link for a new password.

auth.displayNameHint: Optional. This is how the account will address you.

rules.spaces: No spaces at the start or the end

errors.invalid_credentials: Wrong email or password. After 5 failed attempts sign-in is blocked for 15 minutes.
errors.email_taken: This email is already registered. Sign in or reset the password.
errors.password_length: The password must be 10 to 256 characters long.
errors.password_too_weak: The password is too simple: use at least 4 different characters and no spaces at the edges.
errors.password_unchanged: The new password must differ from the current one.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
errors.limit_reached: The limit of records is reached. Delete some and try again.
errors.not_found: The item was not found or is no longer published.
errors.invalid_token: The link is invalid or has expired.
errors.generic: The action failed. Please try again.

favorites.lead: Items you marked with the “Add to favourites” button.
favorites.emptyText: Open a document, an exhibition or a news item and press “Add to favourites” next to the title.

favorite.signInHint: Sign in to your account to save items

selections.lead: Themed lists of documents. A document goes into a selection from favourites.
selections.emptyText: Think of a name and press “Create selection”. Then add documents from favourites.
selections.count: {count, plural, =0 {No documents} one {# document} other {# documents}}
selections.allAdded: All documents from favourites are already in this selection.
selections.needFavorites: To add a document, save it to favourites first: open the document in the catalogue and press “Add to favourites”.
selections.deleteText: The selection “{title}” will be deleted. The documents stay in favourites.

searches.lead: Queries saved through this form. Click a query to repeat the search.
searches.emptyText: Type a query in the field above: it is saved here and opens in the search.
searches.clearText: All saved queries will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

subscriptions.lead: Tick the topics you are interested in.

exhibitions.title: New online exhibitions
exhibitions.text: A message about every new exhibition on the site.

subscriptions.status: {count, plural, =0 {No subscriptions} one {# topic selected} other {# topics selected}}

account.lead: Email, password and deleting the account.

email.title: Email
email.unconfirmedText: Open the link from the email you received after registration. If there is no email, send it again.
email.sent: The email has been sent. Open the link in it.

password.title: Change password
password.note: After the change you will need to sign in again on other devices.
password.done: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
password.wrongCurrent: The current password is wrong. After 5 failed attempts sign-in is blocked for 15 minutes.

delete.title: Delete the account
delete.text: Favourites, selections, search history and subscriptions are deleted together with the account.
delete.confirmTitle: Delete the account and all data?
delete.confirmText: Favourites, selections, search history and subscriptions will be deleted permanently.

reset.requestSent: If the address is registered, we have sent an email with a link. Check your inbox, including the spam folder.
reset.confirmLead: Choose a new password for your account.
reset.doneText: You can now sign in with the new password.
reset.invalidLink: The link is invalid or has expired
reset.invalidText: Request a new link: press “Forgot password?” on the sign-in page.

emailConfirm.title: Email confirmation
emailConfirm.lead: Checking the link from the email.
emailConfirm.doneText: You can continue working in the account.
emailConfirm.invalid: The link is invalid or has expired
emailConfirm.invalidText: Sign in and send the email again under “Account”.
